name: jev-cc-model-router
description: Picks the model once per session and the effort every turn, using TypeSafe's Jev to judge how hard the task is.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Key for Jev (console.typesafe.ai). Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable. Without a key the router does nothing.

default_mode.title: Default mode
default_mode.description: shadow: judge and show, never rewrite. auto: rewrite model and effort. off: do nothing. /jcmr changes the current session only.

low_model.title: Low tier model
low_model.description: Default: haiku (no effort setting, 200K context; a session whose first prompt picks it stays on it). Type sonnet, opus, haiku or fable, or a full model id (needed on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or a gateway). Type off to disable the tier.

balanced_model.title: Balanced tier model
balanced_model.description: Default: sonnet. Type sonnet, opus, haiku or fable, or a full model id (needed on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or a gateway). Type off to disable the tier.

strong_model.title: Strong tier model
strong_model.description: Default: opus. Type sonnet, opus, haiku or fable, or a full model id (needed on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or a gateway). Type off to disable the tier.

long_model.title: Long tier model
long_model.description: For multi-hour autonomous work. Off by default; type fable (or another alias or a full model id) to enable it.

tier_min_probability.title: Minimum tier probability
tier_min_probability.description: Default: 0.6. On a session's first turn, the model changes only when Jev gives its pick at least this probability.

signal_threshold.title: Signal threshold
signal_threshold.description: Default: 0.7. Probability above which a continuation, a complaint about the last attempt, or a high-stakes task counts.

min_effort.title: Minimum effort
min_effort.description: The lowest effort the router will set.

max_effort.title: Maximum effort
max_effort.description: Default: max. The highest effort the router will set. It applies last, so it wins over the minimum effort and over the high-stakes rule. An effort you set yourself is not capped.

jev_model.title: Jev model
jev_model.description: Default: jev-latest, which follows TypeSafe's newest model; a version such as jev-1.13.0 pins one.

jev_timeout_seconds.title: Jev timeout (seconds)
jev_timeout_seconds.description: Default: 3. How long the first request of each prompt you type waits for Jev before going ahead without its answer. 0.5 to 8; a hook may not run past 10 seconds.

send_assistant_tail.title: Send the end of Claude's last reply
send_assistant_tail.description: Also send the last ~1000 characters of Claude's previous reply to Jev, so a short answer such as 'ok' is judged against what it answers.
